title: Colorado State Hospital Museum
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Hello everyone! Stephanie here. I apologize to those who have emailed inquiries, I have had a schedule change and that limits my time when the museum is open. While I haven’t been able to do much research lately, I wanted to reach out and say I haven’t forgotten anyone! I have made up forms that are located on the main floor to submit a request while you are visiting.
hoursText: open every Tuesday and Saturday from 10 am to 4 pm
